notes:
mode: source | registry | local. See docs/pinning.md. registry mode stays unusable until something is actually pushed to ghcr.io/backupdproject/backupd, so source is the only honest default today -- and that registry path does NOT move on this bump. A published image reference is not redirected; it changes with the organisation cutover (FR-41), which is not the in-tree half of backupd#895 and is not in this branch.

Moved to 72c940e for EPIC R's lockstep (backupd#895, R2.5). Every suite here asserts on the CLI's own name, its usage block, its diagnostics and the paths it prints, so those expectations move with the binary: the command is `retnd` from R1.3 (backupd#888), the container's config directory is /etc/retnd from R1.5 (backupd#890), the cookies are retnd_csrf / retnd_session from R1.4 (backupd#889), and this repository's whole RM_* environment contract is RETND_* from this commit.

Measured both ways before the bump rather than after, the way their pin header asks. Against 72c940e: the pre-sweep suite failed 44 of Suite A's 97 cases, and the swept suite passes 97 of 97. Against a build of the sha this line held before, 87a9dc7, the swept suite fails 59 of 97. So the expectations are a test of the product and not of themselves, in both directions.

The jump is large because 87a9dc7 is two renames back -- its command is `backup-manager`, and its package directory is core/cmd/backup-manager, so `source` mode cannot even BUILD it any more: getbuild refuses with "core/cmd/retnd: directory not found". That is this side's half of the one-sided-bump control, watched deliberately: a pin left behind while the other side moves does not produce a subtly wrong run, it produces no run at all. 87a9dc7 also predates the activity verb, backupd#617/#618, #622's storage destinations, #624's proven-source gate, #670, #677, #795's fix and the whole of EPIC L's workflow feature, all of which had been waiting on it.

This is still the half of the lockstep with no automation, and it is now MUTUAL: their scripts/e2e/tests-repo.pin names this repository's merge commit and this line names a commit of theirs, so neither can be read without the other. 72c940e is their main at the time this branch was proved against it, carrying all of R1.1 through R2.4; R2.5's own merge on their side is a later commit, and it changes provenance records, the brand-drift guard and the conformance matrix rather than anything these suites observe, so this line does not have to chase it.

Verified: a stamped build of 72c940e through RETND_MODE=local runs Suite A green, 97 of 97; `source` mode builds ./cmd/retnd and ./cmd/retnd-web from it and the identity handshake agrees; and the whole of scripts/gate-local.sh is green -- gofmt, go vet, the fixture layer and state differ, the harness self-tests, Suite A, both TypeScript type checks and Suite B's 65 unit tests. Suite B collects 312 cases across 23 files and Suite C 13 across 5 under the renamed environment contract; the browser halves need the rig, which is their scripts/e2e/.
